measured_on: MLB regular seasons 2015-2026 (11 season pairs; 2020 prorated); values season-demeaned before every correlation

payloads.players: data/mlb/<S>/hitters.json -> players{pid}.values / pct / pct_role; data/mlb/<S>/pitchers.json -> players{pid}.values / pct / pct_role
payloads.aaa: data/aaa/<S>/... same files and field ids

units_note: fmt 'pct' fields are stored as fractions (0.273 = 27.3 %); Stuff+/Pitching+ are 100 = average; rates 3 dp.
pred_note: pred r is oriented: positive = the better value of the metric (by its direction) goes with the better outcome next season.

groups.peer_group: all hitters (pos != P); compared within level and season

minimum.note: prorated in season: 200 x team_games / 162 (about 1.25 PA per team game). Percentiles stay placed against the site's reference pool (2.1 PA per team game); fielding metrics also need n.chances >= 150, framing n.called >= 2,000.

groups.note: rating = off_rpg + def_rpg + pit_rpg, so rating and pit_rpg correlate 0.91 by construction; the components are kept as the decomposition of the headline number, not as separate evidence. pythag (r 0.94 with baseruns_pct by half) and actual win% sit in the secondary set: BaseRuns is the more reliable and more predictive of the three.
groups.basis: per game / per PA / per BF

payload_changes.field: hitters.json / fielders.json stabilisation k for oaa, fielding_runs, sra (den chances)
payload_changes.note: k=60 chances; measured M50 is about 500 (infield) and 355 (outfield) chances (odd/even games). Raise k to ~400 so a 100-chance fielder is not ranked as if established.
payload_changes.done: e3fa45d8 (OAA k 60 -> 400 chances in hitters.py and fielders.py); live after the next build

payload_changes.builder: oddsmarkets/baseball/models/stabilise.py (c_frame) used by hitters.py and fielders.py
payload_changes.note: k=365 called pitches comes from a raw location-only split-half; year-to-year framing r is 0.54 at ~5,300 called pitches (implied M50 ~4,500). A game-split measure of the model's strikes added is needed before changing it.
payload_changes.done: 9fa856d1 (game-parity split: framing k 365 -> 659 called pitches, display shrinkage); live after the next build

payload_changes.note: Odd/even events within the same games share pitcher, park and umpire, so k is too small (K% 37 v 70 PA by odd/even games, xwOBA 121 v 186 PA, wOBA 369 v 434, whiff 38 v 70 swings). Split by game parity instead.
payload_changes.done: 9fa856d1 (stab-4: odd v even games; projections and WAR keep the validated event-split constants); live after the next build

war.name: Bullpen WAR
war.about: Our wins above replacement: batting, baserunning, fielding and pitching runs over a replacement-level player.

xwoba.name: Expected contact model (xwOBA+)
xwoba.about: Our expected wOBA from exit velocity, launch angle, hang time and sprint speed, plus walks and strikeouts, re-scored in a standard park.

stuff.name: Pitch models (Stuff+, Location+, Pitching+)
stuff.about: Our pitch-quality models: pitch quality from velocity, movement, spin, release and extension (Stuff+), from location (Location+) and both together (Pitching+); 100 = average.

framing.name: Catcher framing model
framing.about: Strikes a catcher adds over an average catcher on the same pitches, and the runs they are worth.

fielding.name: Fielding model (OAA per chance)
fielding.about: Outs above average per chance: plays made beyond what an average fielder makes on the same balls, and the runs they are worth.

decisions.name: Swing-decision model
decisions.about: The run value of a hitter's swing and take decisions per 100 pitches.

team.name: Team rating model
team.about: Runs per game better than average from offence, pitching and defence, from our game model.
